subject: Skybridge CSA: scope confirmation and evidence delegation
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@skybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: cloudsec-team@skybridge.com, procure@skybridge.com
Date: 2026-11-23T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CAIQ package: scope clarification & evidence delegation

Hi Marissa / Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking this on. We kicked off our external CSA review for Q4 and want to confirm the CAIQ scope and artifact handoff timeline before we lock the auditor window. Two quick asks: 

1) Scope: confirm whether Redwood will include the "Dedicated" and "Private (VPC)" deployment modes in scope for Skybridge. Our compliance team needs this to determine sampling.

2) Evidence delegation: please provide a short owner roster (control owner, primary artifact type, expected delivery date) for the controls in the attached baseline set. We need owners for: CCM-03 (identity), CCM-07 (key mgmt), CCM-12 (telemetry), CCM-18 (devsecops), CCM-25 (data residency).

Target timeline: we are aiming to bundle artifacts by 2026-11-30 so our auditors can pre-validate next week. If you can flag any controls that require engineering instrumentation (logs, replay, or KV cache traces), call those out explicitly.

Attachments: baseline_control_list.csv (requested controls), auditor_checklist.pdf (format expectations)

Appreciate it — Elena
Elena Morales
Senior Cloud Security Manager | Skybridge Financial
elena.morales@skybridge.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@skybridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ package: scope clarification & evidence delegation

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Plan below and owners noted.

Quick answers:
- Scope: Redwood will include Hosted + Dedicated in-scope for Skybridge. Private (VPC/on-prem) is out of scope for the initial CAIQ bundle unless you explicitly need it; if so please confirm and we will expand sampling.

Owner roster (high level):
- CCM-03 (Identity & Access): Kimberly Park — artifact: access control matrix & IAM role snapshots — ETA 2026-11-29 (attachment: control_mapping_v1.xlsx)
- CCM-07 (Key Mgmt): Jordan Blake — artifact: key rotation policy + KMS attestation — ETA 2026-11-30
- CCM-12 (Telemetry): Jordan Blake — artifact: log retention excerpt & telemetry schema doc — ETA 2026-11-29
- CCM-18 (DevSecOps): Marissa Cole — artifact: CI/CD policy + vulnerability scan samples — ETA 2026-11-30
- CCM-25 (Data Residency): Kimberly Park — artifact: dataflow diagram + residency statement — ETA 2026-11-30

Flags / notes:
- Jordan: CCM-12 will require a short replay of a representative telemetry export (anonymized). Can you capture a 24-hour log extract and a brief readme describing fields and retention?
- Kimberly: for CCM-25 we should include the short narrative around customer-configurable region pinning (Skybridge asked specifically for residency).

Attachments I am uploading now: control_mapping_v1.xlsx (mapping + proposed artifacts), caiq_response_draft_v2.pdf (narrative draft). I will also open a shared Drive folder and add the file list.

If that looks good, Kimberly and Jordan can confirm below and we will mark items for delivery.

Thanks — M
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security 
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

All good from my side — confirming owners and adding detail: 
- CCM-03 (Identity & Access): I will provide an access-control CSV export (last 90 days) and a short authoritativeness statement. ETA: 2026-11-29 EOD.
- CCM-25 (Data Residency): I will draft the residency narrative and attach the dataflow diagram. NOTE: we will reference the regional storage keys in the retention table — Jordan, can you confirm which S3 buckets are tagged for eu/us?

Artifacts will be uploaded to the Drive folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSKYBRIDGE-caiq) by 2026-11-29. I flagged CCM-12 and CCM-07 as requiring short operational proofs (log slice and KMS attestation respectively).

Subject: Re: CAIQ package: scope clarification & evidence delegation

Marissa / Kimberly — this is great, thank you for the rapid turnaround. Two small follow-ups before we close the window: 

1) Can you add a one-paragraph narrative for CCM-25 (Data Residency) that explicitly states how customer data is partitioned and what controls prevent cross-region replicas? That helps our auditor confirm residency assertions without deeper sampling.

2) Would you include a SOC 2 crosswalk (pointer to the SOC 2 control IDs that map to the CAIQ controls you are submitting)? A simple two-column CSV is fine — "CAIQ_ID, SOC2_Control".

If you can drop both into the Drive folder today or early tomorrow, we will proceed to pre-validation. We may follow up with a brief audit call next week.

Thanks again — Elena
